description: This file defines a React functional component 'SettingsModal' that provides a user interface for managing user account details, language preferences, and theme settings within a modal dialog. It includes UI elements like tabs, forms, and buttons, and interacts with Firebase authentication to fetch user data.

methods.name: SettingsModal
methods.description: React functional component that renders a settings modal dialog with user profile management, language selection, and theme options.

methods.name: handleSaveProfile
methods.description: Handles saving the user profile, currently logs the profile data to console and exits editing mode.
